name: Card Image
description: A pressable card pairing an image with a leading/title/subtitle/trailing text block.

fields.hoverScale: double? - image scale while hovered; null = 1.05
fields.normalScale: double? - image scale at rest; null = 1
fields.imageBackground: ThemedColor? - image fill; null = transparent token
fields.imageBorderColor: ThemedColor? - image border; null = transparent token

notes: `ButtonStyle.fixed(density: compact)` is deleted; the card runs on `ButtonSize.icon` (chrome-free, zero padding) with the `cardImageButtonStyle` leg, which reproduces the old fixed look.
The old `style`/`direction`/`hoverScale`/`normalScale`/`backgroundColor`/`borderColor`/`gap` widget arguments are theme fields now (clean break).
`Basic` is the `primitives/layout.dart` primitive (the old `layout/basic` component), so `deps.components` holds only `button` and `outlined_container`.
